correctness.rationale: Using the displayed metric, set \(a_i=|v_i|/(1-|z_i|^2)\). For the source map \(f_0(z)=(z_1,\ldots,z_1)\), exact substitution gives \(F_{t,k}^2(f_0(z);df_0v)=K_{n,t,k}^2a_1^2\). Equality with the sharp bound is therefore equivalent to \(a_1^2=[\sum_i a_i^2+t(\sum_i a_i^{2k})^{1/k}]/(1+t)\). Each bracketed component is at least \(a_1^2\); equality holds exactly when \(a_i=0\) for all \(i\ge2\). This remains valid at \(t=0\), where only the first term is present.
